status: runner implemented; inference not yet authorized by resource gate
hypothesis: Explicit low-overhead codes may reduce measured application-layer communication while preserving exact matching accuracy on a fixed, shared task. This pilot cannot establish general superiority.
task: Role-separated deterministic private-record matching. Sender sees one target tuple; receiver sees a shuffled table of unique candidate tuples. Target index is sampled independently and uniformly.
secondary_outcomes: receiver payload tokenizer count (null unless separately measured)
exact semantic fidelity for mechanically decodable formats

design.message_channel: measured length-prefixed loopback TCP; application-layer envelope, prefix, and acknowledgement counted; TCP/IP/link-layer headers excluded
design.tokenizer_usage: provider-reported total prompt/completion counts; do not infer the message-only token count from total receiver prompt usage

resource_gate.required: Before any model execution, satisfy all thresholds in experiments/index_v0_3/preregistration.json on the current machine; no remote/cloud inference.

analysis.frontier: report success against application bytes, reported model tokens, and wall time; do not combine these into a scalar unless a cost model is specified
analysis.claims: No superiority claim from this pilot alone; compare confidence intervals and repeat across model populations and task scales before making general claims.
